title: WalletHub
tagline: WalletHub is a platform that allows you to manage your wallets and transactions.
description:
🚀 Self-Hosted Server Wallet Manager 🔐

I'm developing an open-source solution that allows users to run a server wallet on their own infrastructure. This wallet manager enables:

✅ Automated Investments – Seamlessly invest in DEXs based on predefined strategies.
✅ Scheduled Token Transfers – Set up automated token transfers at specific times.
✅ Policy-Based Security – Auto-detect suspicious actions and apply blocking policies.
✅ Self-Hosted & Secure – Full control over your wallet without relying on third parties.

This project is designed for developers, DeFi enthusiasts, and businesses that need customizable, automated blockchain transactions.

💡 Looking for contributors & feedback! Let’s build something powerful together.
how_its_made:
🛠 How I Built It
Tech Stack
Next.js – Server-side rendering and API routes for efficient performance.
Tailwind CSS – Modern, utility-first styling for a clean UI.
Inngest – Reliable background jobs and event-driven workflows.
Privy – Seamless authentication and wallet management.
viem – Lightweight, modern Ethereum client for blockchain interactions.
